pr_title: roachtest: validate token return in perturbation/* tests
pr_body:
This commit adds validation that all RAC tokens are returned on all stable nodes at the end of the test.

Fixes: #133410

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/133616)
FYI - I haven't tested this on full clusters, but I have on a dev cluster. I plan to validate on all the tests in the morning, before merging it.

TFTR!

I ran all 8 perturbation tests with the token return validation and they all passed. Merging.

bors r=kvoli

issue_context.title: roachtest: assert that tokens available returns to near full in perturbation tests
issue_context.body:
We should assert that the tokens available returns to near full in the `pertubation/*` roachtests, after the test has completed running the recovery phase.

This will provide some degree of coverage for token leakage, or liveness bugs.

Jira issue: CRDB-43589

Epic CRDB-37515

review_comments: Does this check assume that all writes are stopped? What happens when there are some internal/background writes happening in CRDB despite the workload is stopped - can this perpetually not converge?
I think it works because of the succeeds soon, but relevant to my above comment. Writes are stopped, but not internal ones (which shouldn't deduct tokens).

Correct, this check only works if the system is mostly quiescent, which it is for this test. I was considering trying to do something while it was running, but that seems more complex, and having "exact match" at the end seemed better.
